title: RabbitMQ Consumer with Python and Pika
title_es: Consumer de RabbitMQ con Python y Pika
description: Runnable RabbitMQ producer and consumer using pika: durable queues, manual acknowledgments, dead-letter exchange, prefetch tuning, and reconnection-safe consumer.
description_es: Productor y consumer de RabbitMQ ejecutables con pika: colas durables, acknowledgments manuales, dead-letter exchange, ajuste de prefetch y consumer con reconexión.
